author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Gameplay trailer for Okko The Exiled, a 2D side-scrolling action platformer developed by Frozen Flame Interactive. Players will embark on an action-packed adventure where they stomp, launch, deflect, and bash their way through Kutala, a land of demons, and overthrow the Demon Lord Yalda. Unleash your powers and help Okko fight to fulfill an ancient oath. Okko The Exiled is coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5) and PC (Steam).
title: Okko The Exiled - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the GIGA Update Trailer for IT Specialist Simulator, an immersive information technology simulation game developed by Pixel Team RED. The GIGA Update includes a massive new update introducing programming, development tools, databases, version control, new server systems, educational content, and numerous improvements across the game. In IT Specialist Simulator, players diagnose a suite of issues, from network problems, server issues, and more, to solve problems and rise through the ranks. IT Specialist Simulator is available now on PC (Steam).
title: IT Specialist Simulator - Official GIGA Update Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Lizzo Gameplay Reveal Trailer from Combo Devils, the 2D platformer arcade beat-em-up developed by Punkzilla. Lizzo, the retired Kaiju is here! He is the next fighter in Combo Devils as a Heavy/Grappler. Lizzo will be playable in Closed Beta weekends until launch. You can get access to the closed betas by backing the Kickstarter. Combo Devils is coming to PC (Steam) in spring 2027.
title: Combo Devils - Official Lizzo Gameplay Reveal Trailer

description:

Get the power back on, face all manner of creatures, and escape in The Well Is Not Empty, available now for PC (Steam).

#TheWellIsNotEmpty #Gaming #IGN
title: The Well Is Not Empty - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the release date trailer for Night Maniac: The Origin of Steven, a narrative horror set in Red Valley in the year 1948. Follow Steven Watson, a cold, methodical, and increasingly isolated young man whose routine at the slaughterhouse begins to blur with a darker and more disturbing reality. What seems like just another day of work slowly turns into a descent into the cruelest side of Red Valley. Night Maniac: The Origin of Steven is out now on PC (Steam).
title: Night Maniac: The Origin Of Steven - Official Release Date Trailer

description:

Marvel Tokon Fighting Souls is out now for PlayStation 5 (PS5) and PC (Steam).

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at the announcement trailer for SOMNIUS, a chaotic co-op extraction game for up to 6 players developed by STFGames. Players will dive into collapsing dreams, turn anything into ammo, feed the portal to buy more time, and save the Dreamer before the dream burns away. SOMNIUS launches on PC (Steam) on September 22. 
Steam:  https://store.steampowered.com/app/3882630/SOMNIUS/
title: SOMNIUS - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
As Valheim’s 1.0 launch approaches, we look back at what was and towards the future at what will be. Thank you for embarking on this magical journey with us - a journey that’s yours, as much as ours. 
Before journeying to the snowy biome, take a look back at the adventure. Join the team at Iron Gate for a behind-the-scenes look at the development of Valheim over the years in this new video for the open-world survival-crafting action-adventure game. The new video also features community members sharing their experiences playing. Finally, get a new look at the Deep North biome coming to version 1.0 of Valheim. Valheim is available now on Steam, Windows PC, Xbox, Humble, and Mac App stores. Version 1.0 of Valheim and the Deep North update will be available on Steam, Windows PC, Xbox Series X/S, Xbox One, Humble, Mac App stores, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Nintendo Switch 2 on September 9, 2026.
title: Valheim - Official (Y)our Journey Developer Behind-The-Scenes

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the latest Champion Spotlight for Riots 2v2 tag fighter 2XKO. Lux is a tricky hybrid zoner and rushdown fighter. She can overwhelm opponents with her superior speed and unique airdash to bait opponents into making a mistake and leaving themselves open to big damage. She can also control the screen space with her plethora of projectiles, pushing an opponent into the corner to break through their defence with her setup tools. 

Lux joins the 2XKO roster on September 8th for PlayStation 5 (PS5), PC, and Xbox Series X|S.
title: 2XKO - Official Lux Champion Spotlight Trailer

The case involves werewolves and, most terrifying of all, traffic. The Darkside Detective: Backside of the Moon will be available on PC in 2027. A demo is out now.
title: The Darkside Detective: Backside of the Moon - Official Case Reveal Trailer | Akupara Direct

author: GameTrailers
description:
You got the U.S.S. Voyager home once, yet Q isn’t fully impressed and offers you even more challenges. Watch the latest Star Trek: Voyager - Across the Unknown trailer to see what to expect with the Q Trials, a new roguelike game mode that lets Q do what he does best: mess with the rules. Star Trek: Voyager - Across the Unknown's Q: Trials and the Equinox DLC will be available on PC, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X|S on October 1, 2026.

The new trailer, featuring John de Lancie (who plays Q), showcases the Q Trials roguelike mode, which makes life in the Delta Quadrant more demanding with randomized events, changing routes and challenges, while giving more freedom in how you build your crew and turns each journey through the Delta Quadrant into a different test. 

In addition to the free update, the Equinox DLC also launches, adding the U.S.S. Equinox as a playable ship for Q Trials, together with Captain Rudolph Ransom, Maxwell Burke, and Noah Lessing.
title: Star Trek: Voyager - Across the Unknown - Official Q Trials Announcement Trailer
